name: @nerima-games/mc-playground-kit
description: Dev-only preview harness for the nerima-games Minecraft-clone rebuild: launch options, boot phase budget, and the glue that stands up a mini world + camera + renderer + input in about a second.
author: takeokunn

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --pretty false && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --pretty false && tsc -p tsconfig.preview.json --pretty false
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings index.ts domain application scripts test apps
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix index.ts domain application scripts test apps
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm check:deps && pnpm api:check && pnpm test
